newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hongkong Bank, BNZ raise fixed mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank, BNZ raise fixed mortgage rates.

text.p: Hongkong Bank, which dropped its floating mortgage rate earlier on Friday, was later joined in raising its fixed rates by the Bank of New Zealand.
Despite rising bill rates, Hongkong Bank dropped its floating mortgage rate to 9.60 percent from 9.75 percent in an attempt to attract customers from other banks, retail manager Alex Bentley said.
The rate is effective immediately for new customers and from Wednesday for existing customers.

HongkongBank's one-year fixed rate moves to 8.95 percent from 8.65 percent, the two- and three-years to 9.50 percent from 9.25 percent, and the four- and five-year rates to 9.90 percent from 9.60 percent.
